shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "-----" && ls -la && echo "-----" && cat AGENTS.md && echo "-----" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/

echo "=== src ===" && find src -type f | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "--- {}"; cat {}' && echo "=== index.html ===" && cat index.html && echo "=== tsconfig ===" && cat tsconfig.json && echo "=== vite ===" && cat vite.config.ts && echo "=== gitignore ===" && cat .gitignore && echo "=== ls __agent_eval__ ===" && ls -R __agent_eval__ && echo "=== routing head ===" && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== navigation / router entries ===" && rg -n -i -C 3 'navigation|router|app shell|aside' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ && echo "=== uikit version ===" && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== traps ===" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40

node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').version + ' / i18n ' + require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@bem-react 2>/dev/null; npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 2>&1 | tail -5 && node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json').version" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs && cat $D/INDEX.md | head -120 && echo "=== components ===" && ls $D/components $D/hooks && echo "=== README required setup ===" && rg -n -i -C 12 'required setup|install|import .*styles|css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md | head -80

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components && rg -n -C 3 'menuItems|renderFooter|renderContent|logo|headerDecoration|onChangeCompact|compact|MenuItem|FooterItem|panelItems|subheaderItems|onClosePanel|current|onItemClick|multipleTooltip' $D/AsideHeader.md | head -220

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components && echo "=== AsideHeader props table ===" && rg -n '^\|' $D/AsideHeader.md | head -80 && echo "=== FooterItem / MenuItem in d.ts ===" && rg -n -A 30 'export interface FooterItemProps|export type FooterItemProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -60; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm -name '*.d.ts' | rg -i 'FooterItem|types' | head; echo "=== MenuItem type ===" && rg -n -B2 -A 40 'export interface MenuItem\b|export type MenuItem\b|export interface AsideHeaderItem|export type AsideHeaderItem\b' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -90; echo "=== exports ===" && head -40 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts

F=/home/node/.claude/projects/-home-sandbox-workspace/a3b81792-a442-498e-a73d-14b1484ab36d/tool-results/bbkzymtoq.txt && rg -n '^\d+:\| (logo|menuItems|renderFooter|renderContent|headerDecoration|hideCollapseButton|compact|onChangeCompact|customBackground|customBackgroundClassName|menuDensity|subheaderItems|panelItems|multipleTooltip|qa|className|topAlert|onClosePanel) ' $F | sed -E 's/ {2,}/ /g' | cut -c1-400; echo "=== sections ==="; rg -n '^=== ' $F; echo "=== after props table ==="; awk '/=== FooterItem/{p=1} p' $F | sed -E 's/ {2,}/ /g' | head -170

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && echo "=== components/types.d.ts (AsideHeaderItem/MenuItem) ===" && sed -n 1,140p $N/components/types.d.ts && echo "=== FooterItem.d.ts ===" && cat $N/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts && echo "=== Logo props ===" && rg -n '^\|' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/Logo.md | sed -E 's/ {2,}/ /g' | cut -c1-300 | head -30

mkdir -p /tmp/gdocs && curl -sS -m 40 -o /tmp/gdocs/uikit7.txt -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt; head -c 600 /tmp/gdocs/uikit7.txt; echo; echo "=== icons available (check names) ==="; for n in House Gear Person Sun Moon CircleInfo Rocket Palette Globe Bell Star Heart Cubes3 LayoutHeaderCellsLarge Persons ChartColumn FileText Envelope; do if [ -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$n.js ]; then echo "OK  $n"; else echo "NO  $n"; fi; done; echo "=== icons entry ==="; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -5; node -p "require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').main + ' | ' + JSON.stringify(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').exports ? Object.keys(require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json').exports).slice(0,5) : null)"

echo "=== llms index: theme/switch/card hits ===" && rg -n -i 'ThemeProvider|useTheme|Switch|Card\b|\bText\b|Flex|Container|Label\b|Breadcrumbs|Divider' /tmp/gdocs/uikit7.txt | head -40 && echo && echo "=== inspect-package ===" && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch Card Text Flex Container Button Label 2>&1 | head -60

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && echo "=== ThemeProvider ===" && cat $U/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && echo "=== theme exports / useTheme ===" && cat $U/theme/index.d.ts && cat $U/theme/useTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat $U/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "=== Switch ===" && cat $U/Switch/Switch.d.ts && rg -n -A 25 'export interface ControlProps|export interface BaseInputControlProps|export type ControlProps' $U/types.d.ts | head -45; echo "=== Card ===" && sed -n 1,60p $U/Card/Card.d.ts; echo "=== Text ===" && sed -n 1,60p $U/Text/Text.d.ts; echo "=== Text variants/colors ===" && rg -n 'TEXT_VARIANTS|TEXT_COLORS|TextProps' $U/Text/text/text.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,40p $U/Text/text/text.d.ts; sed -n 1,40p $U/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts; echo "=== Flex ===" && sed -n 1,80p $U/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts; echo "=== Container ===" && sed -n 1,40p $U/layout/Container/Container.d.ts; echo "=== Button ===" && rg -n 'view\?|size\?|onClick|children|extraProps|ButtonView|ButtonSize' $U/Button/Button.d.ts | head -20

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && rg -n -B1 -A6 'AsideHeaderItem\b' $N/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -40; echo "=== FooterItem usage in docs ==="; rg -n -B4 -A14 'renderFooter=\{' $N/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | sed -n 1,60p; echo "=== exports ==="; rg -n 'AsideHeader|FooterItem|PageLayout' $N/esm/components/index.d.ts

N=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && rg -n 'AsideHeaderItem\s*=|interface AsideHeaderItem' -A 8 $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== AsideHeader index exports ==="; cat $N/components/AsideHeader/index.d.ts; echo "=== renderFooter signature (docs line 401 said {size}); check d.ts ==="; rg -n 'renderFooter|renderContent' $N/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts $N/components/types.d.ts | head

''') open(p,'w').write(s) EOF npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20
